objects.description: For [Operation Spalax](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0005), the threat actors obtained malware, including [Remcos](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0332), [njRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0385), and AsyncRAT.(Citation: ESET Operation Spalax Jan 2021)
objects.description_fa: برای [عملیات Spalax](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0005)، بازیگران تهدید بدافزار، از جمله [Remcos](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0332)، [njRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0385)، و AsyncRAT را دریافت کردند.[[VE_0]PRES]ER. (Citation: ESET Operation Spalax Jan 2021)
